h1: AI Product Video Generator: Link, Avatar and Script
lead: AIVideosUGC builds a product video from a product link or one photo. An avatar (an AI actor, not a real customer) can hold the item or show it in use. A script and a spoken voice explain the product. You can post to TikTok or Meta (Facebook and Instagram), or download the file with no watermark. Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.

benefits.d: A few choices are enough to get a product video. You do not need an editing background.
Change the script, the voice, the pictures and your logo until the clip fits your shop.
Pick a natural AI voice from the voice library and let it read the script.
Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 a month for 300, and Premium is $63 a month for 600. A 6-second video is 24 credits, shown before you start.

steps.t: Add a Link or a Photo

faq.q: How do I make a video for a product I sell?
faq.a: Paste the product link. We read the page and write a script. You pick the pictures and an AI actor. You can post the clip to TikTok or Meta, or download it with no watermark.

faq.q: How do I create product videos with AI?
faq.a: Give a product link, pick a style and an AI actor, then approve or edit the script. Scenes, a spoken voice that sounds human, and captions are added. You can also make several versions at once for a test.

faq.q: How long should a product video be?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. A short clip fits TikTok or a social post. Use 15 or 30 seconds when the action needs more time. They cost 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits, in that order.

faq.q: Can AI make a clear product demo?
faq.a: Yes. An AI actor can explain the feature. You also get shots of the product in use, plus extra shots. You do not book a live filming day.

faq.q: How does a product link become a video?
faq.a: We read the product page for the images, the title, the description and the features. A script is written from those selling points and paired with the pictures and an AI actor.

faq.q: Can I customize the product video?
faq.a: Yes. Edit the script, swap the AI actor, or change the scene. Pick a song from the music library. Set your colors and add your logo in the built-in editor. You can also speak the script in another language.

faq.q: How is an AI product video different from a filmed one?
faq.a: You skip the filming. You pay in credits, and you see the cost first. You can make another version from the same link. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. If a video fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: How do I make the video match my shop?
faq.a: Add your logo and colors. Pick a voice that fits. Edit the script until the line sounds like your shop. Your own tools can also start the same job through the API.

picker.title: Sample Product Videos
picker.lead: Open one if you want a similar action, AI actor and script.

cards.label: Umbrella opens for coverage
cards.prompt: Hands open the compact umbrella on a rainy sidewalk and stop when the canopy is fully open. Keep the umbrella's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Folding bike hinge opens
cards.prompt: Hands unfold the compact bicycle once and pause with the central hinge fully open. Keep the bike's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Desk lamp switches on
cards.prompt: A hand presses the desk lamp switch once. Warm light spreads across the desk, then the lamp stays on. Keep the lamp's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Drawer trays slide into place
cards.prompt: Hands slide the divided trays into an open drawer and stop when the compartments line up. Keep the drawer's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Travel charger packs away
cards.prompt: Hands coil the cable and pack the compact charger into a fabric travel pouch, then close the pouch. Keep the charger's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Laptop sleeve opens for fit
cards.prompt: Hands open the padded laptop sleeve and slide a laptop halfway in, so the fit is visible. Keep the sleeve's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

cards.label: Lunchbox latch clicks shut
cards.prompt: Hands close the divided lunchbox and press the side latch once, until the seal is shut. Keep the lunchbox's shape and color as in the photo. Add a short voiceover and captions.

definition.title: What Is an AI Product Video Generator?
paras: An AI product video generator makes a short product video from a link or a photo. An avatar can hold the item or show it in use, and a script plus a voiceover explain it.
Edit the line, swap the avatar, pick a music-library track and add your logo before you publish to TikTok or Meta, or download the file with no watermark.

Turn the product description into a script and a spoken voice that sounds human. It covers the benefits and the doubts a shopper has.
